caption: Unpopular opinion: remakes are killing new ideas. Agree or disagree? #hottake #remake #residentevil #gaming #fyp

instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: remakes are killing new ideas.

Resident Evil 4 got a full remake while the original still plays great. That budget could have built something new. The Last of Us Part I remade a game that was nine years old and already remastered once. Every studio that spends years on a remake is a new world that never gets made. Agree?
